name: F-box protein 11

function.text: FBXO11 encodes f-box only protein 11. Annotated molecular activities include protein-arginine N-methyltransferase activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in protein ubiquitination and sensory perception of sound.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual developmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Burkitt Lymphoma; Malignant Lymphoma; Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
